notes.title: Christmas in the Bunker!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/f2381f46369dd44705127a1a497192ab8c7e6989.png[/img]
[h3][b]MERRY CHRISTMAS SOLDIERS![/b]
Celebrate this special time of the year in your bunker![/h3]
[list]
[*] Christmas items - yes!
[*] Christmas atmosphere - yes!
[*] Christmas presents - yes!
[*] Christmas everything- yes!
[/list]
We prepared a special Christmas event for this occasion.
[b]Dress up your freshly delivered conifer which you can find in your room (you have time till December 31st), prepare the letter, and receive wonderful gifts![/b]
All that while eating delicious candy canes and snow melting on your helmet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/e4a53afe06716353033d5a6e82df10a9e4203a74.png[/img]
The Word is that goblins in your area have loads of Xmass decorations in their possession.
They surely won't mind if you borrow some from them (what will the dead goblin need Christmas tree decorations for?)

[h3]Gifts are coming between December 27th and December 31st![/h3]
Santa Claus is open to every request so you can write him a letter - the paper is on your bedside table.
[b]But beware, if you want to receive what you wish, your Xmas tree needs to be fully dressed by December 27th!
[/b]If it won't be ready you'll get only one gift with random trash inside.

merry Xmas,
Bunker Dev Team

notes.title: Preparing for the Release 10.10.2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/0bfcdf125c64ba7a3cd082f7168bd6528bed8f49.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Soldiers![/b][/h3]
It's been a long time since WW2: Bunker Simulator EA launched. 
The game in September 2021 was vastly different, unfinished in some cases, product.
We've listened to you guys [b](big thanks for the support from our [url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp]Discord[/url], without you the game wouldn't be the same! <3)[/b] and worked hard. 

[b]Here is a brief list of things added in EA:
- improvements to enemy AI 
- MG companion balance 
- Overall MG rework
- Utility orders (taking the rubble out and finishing the sandbags projects)
- Companion Healing and HP tunning
- Companion Thirst, Hunger, and Energy
- bunker doors mechanic
- mines field and mechanics improvements
- anti-tank gun improvement
- special Halloween Event
- special Christmas Event
- audio improvements
- additional save slots
- new tutorial
- key bindings
- trash can for useless items/ingredients
- looting enemy ammo from the weapon
- inventory improvement (assigning items to hotkeys by hoovering; slot scrolling, shift information)
- companion marker
- enemy body disappear after looting (for less powerful PCs)
[/b]

After all this introduction...
[h3][b]We proudly announce that WW2: Bunker Simulator will leave Early Access on the 10th of October![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/865937fc930a3649fb8415c30a02669f5beedee9.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/XSvDn5e3Zp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/75fc285aa7879bdfdae914b03e05558bc380dd67.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Halloween Update v2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/8c7794d8747e8bd46a5dd88947cff6d3359801ab.png[/img]

[h3]SOLDIERS![/h3]
[h3]After tough battles with pumpkinheads and zombies, you will receive support. At the same time, be warned, the zombie hour has come.[/h3]

The second version of the Halloween update supplements our event with new functionalities.

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Candies [/b]in the opponents bodies - they give you energy to make it easier to get through the long nights
[*] [b]Pumpkin bombs[/b]. You can find them in the opponents bodies. They work like grenades, but are more powerful and have a longer range.
[*] [b]Scythe [/b]- the Boss Butcher often has it with him. You can also find the scythe by searching the mummies. The scythe can come in handy when fighting zombies. Has a slightly greater range than the ax and deals more damage.
[*] Instead of birds, bats fly at night.
[*] Night animal sounds,
[/list]
[b]All the things you’ll earn during Halloween will stay with you![/b]

[h3]QOL Halloween[/h3]
[list]
[*] More, more zombies.
[*] Pumpkinheads no longer laugh after being killed by grenades.
[*] When the zombie enters the bunker, you will hear an alarm sound.
[*] When the boss butcher goes to the bunker, in addition to the health bar, a warning message will appear on the screen.
[/list]

[h3]QOL global game[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]ACHTUNG![/b] During missions with infantry, enemies can launch an attack at the back of the bunker. Be cautious :)
[*] We've slightly reduced the drop of pills in enemy bodies.
[*] In response to your feedback, you may occasionally receive 1 mission to complete during the day. This will give you more time to manage your resources and prepare for the fight in the coming days.
[*] Gewehr will be more accurate.
[*] Localization corrections.
[/list]

Still based on your feedback, we are trying to fine-tune the game balance. 

If in your opinion the game is too difficult, too easy or you get too much of the items, please visit our DISCORD server. We welcome any feedback and often take it into account in future updates.


Feel free to join our DISCORD server:

[url=https://bit.ly/ArtGamesDC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849585/75fc285aa7879bdfdae914b03e05558bc380dd67.jpg[/img][/url]

Instead of birds, bats fly at night.
